All Addl. CPFC s — in Charge of Zones,

All Regional P.F. Commissioners — in Charge of Regions,

Sub: - Compliance of International Workers — reg.

As you are well aware that the substituted Para 2(ja)(b) under Para 83 of the EPF
Scheme defines an International Worker as “an employee other than an Indian employee,
holding other than an Indian Passport, working for an establishment in India to which the
Act applies”.

Subject to provisions of the substituted Para 2(f) and the proviso to Para 2(ja), under
Para 83 of the EPF Scheme, any employee working in an establishment covered under EPF
& MP Act 1952 and holding a foreign Passport is an International Worker.

It has been brought to the notice of this office that the field offices are facing
difficulties in obtaining data of International Workers working in their jurisdiction. Following
the issue, the Head Office has collected data of International Workers from reliable sources.

In order to facilitate compliance in the field offices and ensure effective enforcement
of the Scheme provisions, data of International Workers working in India was sent to all the
Zonal offices on 01.03.2019.

It is requested that compliance must be ensured for all the International Workers
working in India and a monthly progress report in this regard must be sent to the
undersigned by email (acc.hq.caiu@epfindia.gov.in).

Addl. Central P.F. Commissioner (HQ)
(International Workers Unit)
